posts.text:
I am honored to earn the endorsement of the @FloridaChiefs.

Every day, Florida's law enforcement officers put on the badge and risk their lives to protect our families and our communities. 

As Governor, I will always stand with those who serve, ensure they have the resources they need to do their jobs safely and effectively, and continue building on Florida's reputation as the safest and most law-and-order state in America.
posts.summary: Endorses law enforcement, pledges gubernatorial support for police resources

Awesome to hit the campaign trail in Orlando this morning with my friend @AshleyMoodyFL.

Voting in the primary is underway and this crowd was fired up! 

Folks in Central Florida are ready to defend the Florida Dream.
posts.summary: Campaigns for Florida governor, frames race as defending state values

posts.text:
Incredible afternoon in Panama City with @ErikaDonalds. There's nothing like talking with Floridians who love this state as much as we do.

I'm running so the families who built Florida can still afford to live here, surrounded by the Florida they grew up in, with beaches and clean water protected for the next generation.

That's the Florida Dream and it's worth defending.

posts.text:
Stopped by Uncle Ernie’s Seafood in Panama City to talk to some local folks who had to rebuild everything following the devastation Hurricane Michael.

We agreed about the need for drastic permitting reform that lets folks build FAST — a key part of my platform. That goes hand-in-hand with improving the insurance market.

I also heard from a server at the restaurant that President Trump’s No Tax On Tips has been an absolute game-changer!
posts.summary: Advocates permitting reform to speed post-disaster rebuilding

posts.text:
Faith and freedom are at the very heart of why I am running to be Florida's next governor. It’s truly an honor to be endorsed by Florida Faith and Freedom.

In his letter to the Corinthians, Paul wrote, 'where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.' That Spirit guided our forefathers as they dared to forge a new country founded on the inalienable rights given to us by our Creator, not the government.

As Governor, I will and fight for our God-given rights on behalf of every Florida family

We’re seeing more socialist candidates in the open — but this has been the Democrats’ position the entire time.

The Green New Deal. Obamacare. Higher taxes. The second they get in power, they push socialist policies. 

We can’t forget what we’re up against this November. We must win.

posts.text:
Senator Albritton has done excellent work leading the conservative cause as President of Florida's Senate, and I am glad to have him in my corner as we work to beat Florida Democrats this November. 

Ben's experience and support will be critical as we fight to defend Florida's agricultural community, deliver for rural Floridians, and make sure the Florida Dream is accessible for all.
